about: Decision 081, WEB-DESIGN 6.4r: the label, drawn from an item's own data. Every stack runs these cases: labelSpec(item, size) must equal `want` (numbers within `tolerance`; strings, nulls, and array lengths exactly). The spec's shape, its token references and the angle convention are documented at the top of js/label-core.js; geometry comes from design-tokens.json art.label. The monogram is each stack's own (its goldens in the grammar tests). Tests never pin catalog contents: these items are fixtures.

playPage.about: B31 2.1 (WEB-DESIGN 6.4r): the play's label as a printed page, from an index row's name, author, hue, era, life and cast. The web runs these now (js/label.test.js); Swift and Kotlin take them at A1 and D1 and then retire the two 'play without its opening' cases in `cases`. The twelve plays are the design frames' (b31-frames/labels-1440-*.png).
